fields.label: Print Format
fields.description: A print format of Certificate Request.

fields.label: Number Prefix
fields.description: Certificate numbers run per prefix, e.g. BON/{abbr}/{yyyy}/ gives BON/GEC/2026/0001. {abbr} is the company abbreviation, {yy} and {yyyy} the year of issue.

fields.label: Needs Approval
fields.description: Requests of this type are issued only after the approval engine approves them (make an Approval Policy for Certificate Request with the condition doc.needs_approval).

fields.label: Verifiable
fields.description: Issue a Verifiable Document: the printed certificate carries a QR that opens the public /verify page.

fields.label: Transfer Certificate
fields.description: Issuing records the student's leaving date, certificate number and reason, and sets the academic status to Discontinued. Blocked while any dues are outstanding.

fields.label: Fee
fields.description: Charged under the Certificate fee category when the certificate is issued. 0 = free.
